agents.name: god-loop-layers
agents.mission: Create the god-loop phase layer JSONs at v4.4.3/src/pta/layers/god-loop/*.layer.json (INIT, AUDIT, SCORE, DECIDE, PLAN, DISPATCH, COLLECT, VERIFY, AUDIT_RECHECK, PROBLEM_SOLVE, CONTAINER_TEST — the GOD_LOOP_LAYER_SET, 8+ layers) AND wire enterPhase() into god-loop.ts so each phase activates/deactivates its layer. The layers are JSON data per the PTA layer schema (MASTER §4 + PTA spec §2.7): id, description, toolMatchers, banks (descriptive/suggestive/substitute/use), pbaContextBoost, enforcement tier1-4 (6-section warhead standard), threshold, severity, chainRules. enterPhase(phase) deactivates the previous phase's layer and activates the new one. Do NOT touch the firewall layers (that is firewall-layers agent's files).
agents.knownContext: v4.4.3 has god-loop.ts (2364L, 13 phases: INIT->AUDIT->SCORE->DECIDE->PLAN->DISPATCH->COLLECT->VERIFY->AUDIT_RECHECK->PROBLEM_SOLVE->CONTAINER_TEST->PASS/LOOP, PHASE_REQUIRED_TOOLS at :109) and poseidon-enforcer-hook.ts (434L, to be replaced). The PTA engine at v4.4.3/src/pta/engine.ts is DONE (class ParagonToolEngine with registerLayer/activateLayer/deactivateLayer/getTier, consuming MS modules). The 12 MS are built (232/0). ms-layer-loader provides loadLayer(jsonPath)->CompiledLayer + registerLayer. The GOD_LOOP_LAYER_SET mapping is in MASTER §6 + PTA spec §2.13: INIT->init.layer.json, AUDIT->audit-required.layer.json, SCORE->score-evidence.layer.json, DECIDE->decision-findings.layer.json, PLAN->plan-density.layer.json, DISPATCH->wave-dispatch.layer.json, COLLECT->collect-all.layer.json, VERIFY->battery-rerun.layer.json, AUDIT_RECHECK->incremental-audit.layer.json, PROBLEM_SOLVE->diagnosis-required.layer.json, CONTAINER_TEST->artifact-required.layer.json. enterPhase() activates the matching layer + deactivates the previous. The WAVE_DISPATCH layer example is in PTA spec §2.13 verbatim. Each layer JSON ~100L. The 6-section warhead standard (DETECTED/WHY THIS FIRED/WHAT THIS MEANS/CORRECT BEHAVIOR/SELF-CHECK/RESET PATH) is mandatory in every tier text.
agents.doctrine: R3: t.e.a soft / t.e.b medium / chat.message hard. R6: NO LOCKOUTS — tier 4 gates only the violating layer's toolMatchers; demanded tool + escape hatches always pass. R9: bun. R10: SMOKE_TEST_GUARD naming. R12: [PTA GATE] prefix. Warhead 6-section standard mandatory. The god loop KEEPS its orchestration logic (13-phase state machine, canon docs, wave dispatch, audit integration, container test evaluation) — PTA only replaces the INLINE enforcement (enforcer-hook/watcher/kick). Do NOT rewrite god-loop.ts's phase machine — only add the enterPhase() layer activation wiring.
agents.measurements: Gate: ls v4.4.3/src/pta/layers/god-loop/*.layer.json -> >=8 files; grep 'pta.activateLayer' god-loop.ts -> >=1; bunx tsc --noEmit -> 0 new errors from src/pta/ + god-loop.ts. Tests: a test file asserting each layer JSON is valid per the schema (has id/toolMatchers/banks/enforcement/threshold), loads via loadLayer, and that enterPhase activates/deactivates correctly.
agents.acceptance: DONE when: (1) >=8 layer JSONs exist at src/pta/layers/god-loop/. (2) enterPhase() wired into god-loop.ts (grep 'pta.activateLayer' -> >=1). (3) bunx tsc --noEmit -> 0 new errors. (4) A test proves each layer loads + enterPhase activates/deactivates. (5) god-loop.ts's phase machine is NOT rewritten (only enterPhase wiring added). (6) Zero edits to the firewall layers dir. Return pastes raw tsc + layer-file listing + enterPhase grep.
agents.taskTargets: Task 1 — create the god-loop layer JSONs (INIT, AUDIT, SCORE, DECIDE, PLAN, DISPATCH, COLLECT, VERIFY, AUDIT_RECHECK, PROBLEM_SOLVE, CONTAINER_TEST). Each: id (e.g. INIT_GUARD, AUDIT_REQUIRED, SCORE_EVIDENCE, DECISION_FINDINGS, PLAN_DENSITY, WAVE_DISPATCH, COLLECT_ALL, BATTERY_RERUN, INCREMENTAL_AUDIT, DIAGNOSIS_REQUIRED, ARTIFACT_REQUIRED), toolMatchers watching the tools relevant to that phase, banks (descriptive/suggestive/substitute/use), pbaContextBoost, enforcement tier1-4 (6-section warhead standard), threshold, severity, chainRules (the phase's required tools as prerequisites). Task 2 — wire enterPhase() into god-loop.ts: deactivate previous phase's layer, activate new phase's layer. Task 3 — write a test asserting each layer JSON validates + loads + enterPhase activates/deactivates. Task 4 — full verification (tsc + layer listing + enterPhase grep).
agents.position: Wave 2 of Plan 2. Consumes the PTA engine (Wave 1, done). Provides the god-loop enforcement substrate. The firewall-layers agent (parallel) creates the 7 firewall replacement layers. Wave 3 (container test) validates both layer sets end-to-end.

agents.name: firewall-layers
agents.mission: Create the 7 firewall-replacement layer JSONs at v4.4.3/src/pta/layers/tool-firewalls/*.layer.json: SMOKE_TEST_GUARD, CONFIG_LOCK, TOOL_PERMISSION, PHASE_ENFORCEMENT, HASH_AS_PROOF, CONTAINER_SUBSTITUTION, SHIP_EVIDENCE_GATE. Each layer replaces one of the 7 hand-coded firewalls (MASTER $2.12 mapping). Each is JSON per the PTA layer schema: id, description, toolMatchers, banks (descriptive/suggestive/substitute/use), pbaContextBoost, enforcement tier1-4 (6-section warhead standard), threshold, severity, chainRules. Do NOT touch the god-loop layers dir (god-loop-layers agent's files).
agents.knownContext: v4.4.3 has the PTA engine at src/pta/engine.ts (DONE). The 12 MS are built (232/0). The 7 firewall -> layer mapping is in MASTER $2.12 + PTA spec $2.12: (1) SSTF semantic-smoke-firewall (~1780L) -> SMOKE_TEST_GUARD (bash with inline-exec patterns node -e*/bun -e*/python3 -c*); (2) Config Lock CTX-01..14 (848L) -> CONFIG_LOCK (write/edit to protected paths *config*/*.env*/*plugin*); (3) Trident Tool Block (~50L) -> TOOL_PERMISSION (trident-poseidon from leaf nodes); (4) Poseidon Permissions (434L) -> PHASE_ENFORCEMENT (tools not matching current phase); (5) Hash-as-Proof (~200L) -> HASH_AS_PROOF (bash with hash-verb shapes as verification claims); (6) Container Substitution (~200L) -> CONTAINER_SUBSTITUTION (bun test/docker instead of trident-container-test); (7) Ship Gate (~300L) -> SHIP_EVIDENCE_GATE (ship-intent without evidence). The canonical SMOKE_TEST_GUARD example is in MASTER $4 verbatim (the reference layer). The layer schema is in PTA spec $2.7. ms-layer-loader provides loadLayer(jsonPath)->CompiledLayer. Each layer ~100L JSON. The 6-section warhead standard (DETECTED/WHY THIS FIRED/WHAT THIS MEANS/CORRECT BEHAVIOR/SELF-CHECK/RESET PATH) is mandatory in every tier text.
agents.doctrine: R6: NO LOCKOUTS — tier 4 gates only the violating layer's toolMatchers; demanded tool + escape hatches always pass. R9: bun. R10: SMOKE_TEST_GUARD naming (never 'sstf'). R12: [PTA GATE] prefix. Warhead 6-section standard mandatory. AP-8: the lockout trap is the most critical anti-pattern — tier 4 NEVER bricks the agent. AP-10: do NOT regress STTGF v2 (PBA) — PTA replaces v1 TOOL PARTS only. The 7 layers are the JSON replacements for the hand-coded firewalls.
agents.measurements: Gate: ls v4.4.3/src/pta/layers/tool-firewalls/*.layer.json -> >=7 files; bunx tsc --noEmit -> 0 new errors. Each layer ~100L JSON. Tests: a test file asserting each layer JSON is valid per the schema, loads via loadLayer, and its toolMatchers/banks fire on the intended violation class and suppress on legitimate use (minimal-pair style). The SMOKE_TEST_GUARD fixture (MASTER $4) is the reference — the layer must match its shape.
agents.acceptance: DONE when: (1) >=7 layer JSONs exist at src/pta/layers/tool-firewalls/. (2) Each has id/toolMatchers/banks/enforcement/threshold/severity. (3) bunx tsc --noEmit -> 0 new errors. (4) A test proves each layer loads + the SMOKE_TEST_GUARD one fires on inline-exec and suppresses on legitimate. (5) Zero edits to the god-loop layers dir. Return pastes raw tsc + layer-file listing + test output.
agents.taskTargets: Task 1 — create the 7 firewall layer JSONs per the MASTER $2.12 mapping. Task 2 — write a test asserting each validates + loads + the canonical SMOKE_TEST_GUARD fires/suppresses correctly. Task 3 — full verification (tsc + layer listing + test).
agents.position: Wave 2 of Plan 2. Consumes the PTA engine (Wave 1, done). Replaces the 7 hand-coded firewalls with PTA layers. The god-loop-layers agent (parallel) creates the god-loop phase layers. Wave 3 (container test) validates both layer sets end-to-end.
